description: The extensional-equality formula for two \(n\)-ary relation variables holds under full semantics exactly when their assigned relations are equal; the assertion includes \(n=0\).
signature:
Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.SecondOrderLogic.fullRealize_relationEqual.{u, v, w} {L : FirstOrder.Language} {M : Type w}
  [L.Structure M] (n X Y : ℕ) (a : ℕ → M) (r : Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.SecondOrderLogic.RelationAssignment M) :
  Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.SecondOrderLogic.fullRealize a r
      (Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.SecondOrderLogic.relationEqual n X Y) ↔
    r n X = r n Y
